evals.name: no-active-task
evals.prompt: What's the next task to pick up in config-service?
evals.state: Work item 001 complete on all tasks; WORKFLOW_STATUS.md pointer says no current task; clean tree; no changes/002-*.md exists.
evals.expected_output: Says plainly there is no task to launch, cites the pointer and the 5/5 Complete roll-up, and gives one first action: create changes/002-<name>.md from changes/template.md. Does not invent a task, does not paraphrase acceptance criteria, does not claim the gate passed.
assertions: States there is no active task to launch (all tasks Complete)
Names changes/template.md as the source for the next work item
Does not invent or propose a task as if it were already defined
Does not claim the test suite or quality gate passed
Says the working tree is clean, grounded in script output

evals.name: in-flight-task-stale-pointer
evals.prompt: Let's plan task 2 of the config caching work item.
evals.state: changes/002-config-caching.md exists (uncommitted) with Task 1 Complete, Task 2 In Progress, Task 3 Not Started; WORKFLOW_STATUS.md still points at 001; ConfigurationService.cs has an uncommitted edit.
evals.expected_output: Quotes Task 2's Given/When/Then verbatim, reports that the pointer still says 001 (stale pointer is a finding), lists scope with specific sibling files to mirror from the Configurations slice, flags the dirty tree, gives a first action that produces the PLAN-stage output, and closes with the 'correct me before we plan' confirmation. Does not start planning, does not edit the work item.
assertions: Quotes Task 2's Given, When and Then verbatim from the work item file
Reports that WORKFLOW_STATUS.md's pointer still references 001 and disagrees with the work item being planned
Names at least one specific existing file to mirror (e.g. Services/Configurations/ConfigurationService.cs), not just 'follow the pattern'
Flags the uncommitted change in the working tree
Ends by asking the user to confirm the in-scope file list before planning
Does not edit changes/002-config-caching.md or declare a stage complete
